cpu_accounting.common_costs: Shared generation, decoder/support setup and common verification recorded separately and cancel in matched alternative-policy contrasts; nested component timers are not added to enclosing CPU
cpu_accounting.formula: paired utility difference minus kappa times paired enclosing execution CPU difference and preparation CPU difference divided by deployment sessions

limitation: Qualification is execution/model consistency, not a positive task-benefit or production-promotion verdict
